summary: Allowed entry lookup confirms no rqb headword; mraqabli is quoted incidentally in wld. Its presence inside another root’s example is not a competing lexical analysis.

Preterit mraqab-li contains the first-person l-agent; ko-mraqb-i-le is provisionally plural Infectum plus target -le. The base-form pair is reconstructed and marked proposed; only those two inflected forms are directly attested.
Targets occur with ʕal and as an object suffix; the birth-order clause gives the content/purpose of monitoring. Surveillance while following a man is a second context of the same sense.
Arabic rāqaba is a plausible contact source based on shape and meaning. Arabic stem III and Turoyo II are different numbering systems; no source etymology or conjugation is asserted as verified.
There is no evidence for another Turoyo stem, Detransitive, idiom or light-verb construction.
Confirm the Turoyo II assignment and the reconstructed citation forms mraqable/mraqəb, especially the retained vowel in Preterit versus Infectum syncope.
Verify the Arabic contact history independently; do not assign Arabic stem numbering directly to Turoyo.
At 87/127 the edition translation continues its subject from the preceding verse. A future expanded quote should be aligned to that verse before adding preceding material.
